attendance-day.name: Attendance Day
attendance-day.description: Build the day's attendance list from their export. Keep their codes.

calendar-pack.name: Calendar Pack
calendar-pack.description: Copy instructional days, holidays, and early dismissals from their calendar file.

immunization-present-missing.name: Immunization Present Missing
immunization-present-missing.description: Compare their immunization log to packet PDFs. List complete, incomplete, exempt-as-filed, or stale as they coded it.

missing-enrollment.name: Missing Enrollment
missing-enrollment.description: Index the enrollment PDF folder against their required-page checklist.

pickup-list.name: Pickup List
pickup-list.description: Build a door or aftercare check from their pickup file.

records-request-completeness.name: Records Request Completeness
records-request-completeness.description: Check each records or transcript request against their process checklist.

transcript-request-log.name: Transcript Request Log
transcript-request-log.description: List open transcript requests from their log. Do not send the transcript.

tuition-from-file.name: Tuition From File
tuition-from-file.description: List amounts, due dates, and payment codes from their tuition sheet.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.description: Copy their waitlist in the order they already wrote. Do not promise a seat.
